from tslearn.metrics.dtw_variants import njit_sakoe_chiba_mask

sz1 = s1.shape[0]  # 40
sz2 = s2.shape[0]  # 40
radius = 5

mask = njit_sakoe_chiba_mask(sz1, sz2, radius=radius)

assert mask.shape == (sz1, sz2), "Mask shape must match (sz1, sz2)"
assert mask[0, 0] == True, "Diagonal should be within the band"
assert mask[0, radius + 1] == False, "Cells outside the radius should be False"

# For a 40x40 matrix with radius 5, the number of True cells is:
# 40 (diagonal) + 2 * (39 + 38 + 37 + 36 + 35) = 410
expected_true_cells = 410
assert mask.sum() == expected_true_cells, f"Expected {expected_true_cells} True cells, got {mask.sum()}"

print(f"__CHECK__ njit_sakoe_chiba_mask {mask.sum()}")
